content:
Over the last few weeks, there have been some bizarre claims about UAP, aliens and their craft and now another one older report came up again with talk about reptilian creatures. Read on for more details.

According to Liberation Times, “Former U.S. Army sniper Nick Betts recounted an alleged deadly encounter with reptilian-looking beings on the Liberty Risk podcast back in December last year.”

A Strange Claim

The Daily Mail explained on Instagram that he “claims a military source told him US troops encountered three ‘reptilian’ beings during a secret mission near Area 51.”

The allegations claim that “one American soldier was killed during the encounter and that officials covered up the death.”

Once again, though, like so many other whistleblowers, he never witnessed the incident himself. He said that “the account came from an unnamed member of an elite military unit.”

Other UAP Claims

Why does that matter now? Well, it might marry into what was recently said by David Grusch. We reported that the former Special Advisor to Rep. Eric Burlison claimed that he saw a video about it and reportedly, it shows a UFO crash site with dead aliens in the craft.

Meanwhile, Jay Stratton, a former senior intelligence officer claimed in his new book and in an interview with Fox, that he actually saw aliens and craft with his own eyes. He didn’t mention the armed conflict Nick Betts talked about. But Grusch did. So there seems to be some overlap in the claims.

Still No Proof

The trouble is that so much excitement was generated when Trump’s UAP files started dropping. But so far, nothing’s been established as far as actual aliens go. Craft act mysteriously, but that’s been reported by many people for years.

People React

On the Instagram post shared by E! News on Friday, one person said sarcastically, “They have the technology to fly 900 quadrillion miles and were beaten by some apes with guns in the desert. That makes sense.”

Here are a few more responses from the discussion:

  • “I don’t buy it. Why would the fight only be by Area 51?”
  • “Someone, who knows someone, that knows someone… told him.”
  • “Don’t smoke while at work.”
  • “I think by now it’s safe to say that it’s not even mathematically possible for humans to be alone in a near infinite universe, to honestly even think that is literally insane.”
  • “people are piling up for years now claiming they’ve seen this is starting to get a little crazy.”

Your thoughts? Do you think the old statement by Nick Betts is important because it ties in with what David Grusch was saying recently? Join the discussion and then come back for more interesting news and updates.
